physics-killer-10.material: Kuvavanyo lwe-photoelectric effect apho kubengezelwa ukukhanya komnyama omnye kwiphepha lesinyithi, iziphumo zokulinganisa amandla ehambayo aphezulu ee-photoelectrons kwiingqokelela ezimbini zinjengoko kubonisiwe kwitafile elandelayo. Xa ingqokelela $7.5\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$ $E_k=1.0\,\mathrm{eV}$, xa ingqokelela $9.0\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$ $E_k=1.6\,\mathrm{eV}$. Umlinganiselo ka-Planck $h=4.0\times10^{-15}\,\mathrm{eV\cdot s}$ (ixabiso eliqikelelweyo lengxaki).
